events.title: LangChain SF Meetup: Judgment Calls
events.locality: San Francisco, CA, San Francisco, California, US
events.description: Join us in San Francisco (SoMa) for a night of talks on building with decision models and using them to evaluate agents. Sydney Runkle, a Product Manager on our OSS team, will show how to pair Jev with traditional LLMs to build effective agents. Seán Roche, an Education Engineer, will cover Jev as a judge for agent evals. 🎤 Talk 1: Decision Models and LangGraph with Sydney Most agents send every judgment call to a frontier LLM. That covers which model to route to, which tools to load, whether an action is safe and whether the work is good enough, so each step is slower and more expensive than it needs to be. Decision models like TypeSafe AI's Jev are built for these calls. They don't generate text. They answer typed questions about an agent's state with calibrated probabilities. In this talk, we cover how decision models work, where they fit in an agent harness, and why getting good answers from them is still a context engineering problem. We'll close with a pattern for pairing them with LLMs: cheap by default, frontier on exception. 🎤 Talk 2: Jev as a judge with Seán Code-based evals are fast but narrow, and LLM judges are flexible but slow, expensive, and inconsistent.
